reason: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year, so paying ₹12,990 for Docketra is hard to justify when we've run fine on free spreadsheets and WhatsApp for a decade. On top of that, without live WhatsApp integration, my clients will still message me on WhatsApp anyway.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive?
would_change_my_mind: Pricing matched to Jamku at ₹6,500 a year and native WhatsApp integration so neither my clients nor I have to touch another interface.
